meta.title: Compliance Register — Amazon Associates + FTC
meta.method: Each requirement below was read directly from the official document linked in the row. Nothing here is recalled from memory. Where a document is behind a sign-in wall, that is stated and no value is claimed.
meta.scope_note: This register records what the rules require and what this project does about each one. It is an engineering register, not legal advice.

rules.requirement: The Site must clearly and prominently state the following, or a substantially similar statement previously allowed: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
rules.verbatim_quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
rules.how_this_site_complies: The exact sentence is rendered verbatim in the site-wide footer of every page and again in the disclosure block directly above each product table.

rules.requirement: An affiliate relationship must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously, close to the recommendation. The words “affiliate link” alone are NOT adequate, because consumers may not understand that the linker is paid.
rules.verbatim_quote: Consumers might not understand that “affiliate link” means that the person placing the link is getting paid for purchases made through the link.
rules.how_this_site_complies: Every page carries the plain-language sentence “I get commissions for purchases made through links on this page” (the exact example the FTC gives) immediately beside the outbound links, in addition to the Amazon sentence. The bare phrase “affiliate link” is never used as the only disclosure.

rules.area: Disclosure — a single site-wide notice is insufficient (FTC)
rules.requirement: A single disclosure on the home page is not enough, because a visitor may land directly on an individual review page.
rules.verbatim_quote: A single disclosure on your home page won’t be sufficient because people visiting your site might read individual reviews or watch individual videos without seeing the disclosure on your home page.
rules.how_this_site_complies: The disclosure block is a repeatable component injected into every generated page, not just the home page. The build script fails if any page lacks it.

rules.requirement: Material connections between an endorser and the seller must be disclosed.
rules.how_this_site_complies: Commission relationship disclosed per C-01/C-02; no compensation from any party other than the Amazon Associates Programme is received, and the site states that explicitly.

rules.requirement: Standard commission income is a fixed rate by product category. The published table sets Kitchen at 4.50%.
rules.source_section: Table 1 — Fixed Standard Commission Income Rates for Specific Product Categories
rules.how_this_site_complies: All three products are small kitchen appliances, so 4.50% is the published category rate applied in the revenue model. The model is labelled a projection, not a forecast or guarantee.

rules.requirement: A click opens a 24-hour session; an item added to the cart can complete up to 89 days after the click; the product must ship and be paid for within 180 days.
rules.verbatim_quote: (x) 24 hours elapse from that click … (i) the customer purchases a Product by adding a Product to his or her shopping cart and completing the order for that Product no later than 89 days after their initial click-through of the Special Link … (iii) within 180 days of the purchase, the Product is shipped to, streamed or downloaded by, and paid for by the customer
rules.how_this_site_complies: Documented in the methodology page so the revenue model's assumptions are auditable. No claim of earnings is made.

rules.requirement: The Site may show prices and availability only if Amazon serves the link containing that data, or the data is obtained through the Creators API / PA API under the licence.
rules.verbatim_quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API
rules.how_this_site_complies: STRICT COMPLIANCE DECISION: no Amazon price and no Amazon availability is published anywhere on this site. The only prices shown are the brand's own store prices on chefman.com and emerileveryday.com, each labelled as such and linked to its source. Amazon price cells are deliberately blank and marked unverified.

rules.requirement: “Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.”
rules.verbatim_quote: Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
rules.how_this_site_complies: CONSTRAINT ON THE PRODUCT ROADMAP: the platform's “analyze pricing” capability is scoped to the brand's own published store prices and to on-page analysis of the data the operator is licensed to display. No consumer-facing price tracker, price-drop alert, or price history chart is built. This is called out as an explicit non-feature on the compliance page.

rules.requirement: Amazon customer reviews or star ratings may not be displayed unless obtained through the Creators API / PA API and used per the licence.
rules.verbatim_quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API
rules.how_this_site_complies: No Amazon review text or Amazon star rating appears on the site. The ratings shown are the brands' own storefront ratings, each labelled “brand-store rating” with a link to the brand page it came from.

rules.requirement: Links must use the tagged Special Link format with the Associate's own tag, and must be accessible directly from the Site.
rules.verbatim_quote: All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site. For example, you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
rules.how_this_site_complies: The site stores a single configurable `ASSOCIATE_TAG` in `data/config.json`. Until the operator supplies a real tag, all outbound links render as plain untagged `https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>` links with a visible warning that tagging is pending. The build fails if a tag is configured but malformed.

rules.requirement: No consideration, reward, rebate, discount or other benefit may be offered to anyone for using Special Links.
rules.verbatim_quote: You will not offer any person or entity any consideration, reward, or incentive (including any money, rebate, discount, points, donation to charity or other organization, or other benefit) for using Special Links.
rules.how_this_site_complies: No rewards, loyalty points, giveaways, cashback or 'click to unlock' mechanics exist anywhere on the site or in the roadmap.

rules.requirement: The Associate, and their friends, relatives, employees, contractors and business relations, must not purchase through their own Special Links.
rules.verbatim_quote: you will not directly or indirectly purchase any Product(s) … through Special Links … and you will not permit, request or encourage any of your friends, relatives, employees, contractors, or business relations to directly or indirectly purchase any Product(s)
rules.how_this_site_complies: Stated as an operator obligation in the compliance checklist. No product is ever purchased through the site's own links.

rules.requirement: The referring site must not be obscured. Cloaked links and misleading shorteners are prohibited.
rules.verbatim_quote: You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links)
rules.how_this_site_complies: Outbound links point straight at `https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>` and display the full destination. The build refuses any outbound Amazon link that is not a direct `/dp/<ASIN>` URL. There is no link-shortening layer, no interstitial, and no redirect script.

rules.area: No price or product claims that are inaccurate
rules.requirement: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about any Product.
rules.verbatim_quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.
rules.how_this_site_complies: Every factual cell is either sourced from the brand's own page or left blank. The verifier rejects any populated cell that has no source. Conflicts found between the Amazon title and the brand spec are shown as conflicts, not resolved by picking the friendlier number (F-02, F-03, F-04).

rules.requirement: The Site must contain original content and be publicly available. Sites aimed at children, or containing prohibited categories, are ineligible.
rules.verbatim_quote: Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application.
rules.how_this_site_complies: The site publishes original comparative analysis, a documented verification method, and a source register. It is not directed at children and contains no prohibited category.

rules.requirement: The relationship with Amazon must not be embellished, and Amazon endorsement must not be implied.
rules.verbatim_quote: You will not misrepresent or embellish our relationship with you (including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you)
rules.how_this_site_complies: The footer states the site is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Amazon or the brands named. No Amazon logo, mark or brand asset is used.

rules.requirement: Personalised/negotiated rates and payment minimums are account-specific and served behind authentication.
rules.how_this_site_complies: Not read, not claimed. The site uses only the published Table 1 rate of 4.50% for Kitchen and says so explicitly.

rules.requirement: Amazon Marks may only be used in the manner the Trademark Guidelines allow, and third-party seller/vendor logos may not be used without written authorisation.
rules.verbatim_quote: You cannot display or otherwise use any logo of or content created by any third party seller or vendor on an Amazon Site in connection with any Special Link unless you have obtained from that seller or vendor specific written authorization to do so.
rules.how_this_site_complies: Brand names (CHEFMAN, Chefman, Emeril Lagasse) and model numbers are used descriptively, in plain text, to identify the products. No brand logos, product photography, or Amazon imagery is embedded. All imagery is generated by this project's own CSS, not hotlinked.
implemented_in: all pages — text only, no brand assets

rules.requirement: The Site must disclose its own use of cookies, pixels and third parties, and comply with applicable privacy law.
rules.verbatim_quote: disclosing on your Site accurately and adequately and otherwise satisfying applicable legal requirements, either through a privacy policy or otherwise, the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies
rules.how_this_site_complies: The site is fully static on GitHub Pages: no cookies are set, no analytics is loaded, no third-party scripts, no fonts from a CDN, no tracking pixels. The privacy page states this and notes that clicking an outbound Amazon link then puts the visitor under Amazon's own privacy notice.

rules.requirement: Click and conversion tracking is a legitimate platform goal, but must not be implemented in a way that violates C-11, C-13 or C-19.
rules.how_this_site_complies: The shipped site does no tracking at all. The platform blueprint describes outbound click accounting that stays on the operator's own server, exposes the true destination, and is never used to offer incentives. Marked as a design requirement, not a shipped feature.
